integrity: All six public research files and reproducible finite checker supplied. Exact finite checks do not certify asymptotic results or originality.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to full-memory walks with fixed 0<r<1, a nonzero first step, and deterministic observation time. Finite-time Pareto tails and the scaled local limit use different orders of limits. The known activity-count Mittag-Leffler theorem and classical large-argument asymptotic are acknowledged inputs. No independence of successive waits, uniform two-parameter crossover, definitive priority, or independent mathematical validation is established.
title: Universal far tails and Mittag-Leffler local waits in elephant walks with stops
